steps.name: inventory-oci-resources-and-state-boundary
steps.summary: Verified OCI API authentication and the connected shared Compute, 47 GiB boot volume, reserved IP and network resources. No block attachments or existing state; shared resources remain references under ADR-016. Inventory, provider candidates and recovery boundaries are recorded in inventory.md.

steps.name: codify-existing-oci-infrastructure
steps.summary: Add only confirmed Terraform resources, pinned versions, secret exclusions and backend-disabled validation; prepare import mapping without connecting production state.
steps.blocked_reason: The verified resources all support the shared Compute; no H-Log-exclusive cloud lifecycle owner was identified. Decide whether to manage shared infrastructure in a separate root/state or defer code until dedicated resources exist. Do not create an empty or reference-only Terraform state.

steps.name: adopt-existing-resources-with-no-change-plan
steps.summary: Separately approve backend bootstrap and import/state changes, preserve existing resources, and verify a no-change plan before future approved infrastructure changes.
